# Eilis Holmstead

Eilis Holmstead is currently a Wildfire Sensor Engineer at Glimow Studio, a cutting-edge firm specializing in AI-driven camera networks that identify wildfire ignition points in real time. Since joining Glimow Studio in 2021, Eilis has led the refinement of the Studio’s flagship smart sensor suite, elevating detection speed and accuracy under challenging environmental conditions.

Eilis began her career in 2013 at PyroTrack Networks, where she spent seven years developing next-generation sensor algorithms. During her tenure there, she designed a proprietary smoke detection module — codenamed Project EmberEye — that significantly reduced false positives in early wildfire alerts. This innovation became a core component of PyroTrack’s sensor product line and was credited with improving response times by an average of 18%.

Her specialties include computer vision, sensor fusion, and machine learning techniques tailored to complex outdoor environments. Eilis is known for her hands-on, data-driven working style and her proactive collaboration with cross-disciplinary teams, including hardware engineers, field technicians, and utility vegetation managers.

At Glimow Studio, she partners closely with the R&D Lead and the Field Operations team to deploy and calibrate sensor arrays across wildfire-prone regions in the western Uplands territory, contributing directly to mission-critical wildfire mitigation efforts.

Current employer: [[companies/glimow-studio]].
